businessModel: Paid subscriptions (consumer app) and enterprise remote-browser isolation; OEM preinstall deals
paidNote: Mobile app requires a subscription to work (older App Store listing: $0.99/mo or $4.99/yr; Play Flash listing: about $1/mo); enterprise Puffin Secure Browser is quote-only
summary: Puffin renders pages in CloudMosa's cloud and streams the result to the app, helping weak devices and enabling remote browser isolation. Mobile apps need a subscription; content passes through private servers, which raises privacy concerns.
notFor: People needing intranet or geo-restricted sites

pros.title: Light on the device
pros.detail: HTML rendering happens in the cloud; only rasterization is local.

pros.title: Remote isolation
pros.detail: Enterprise Puffin Secure Browser keeps web content off endpoints.

pros.title: Multiple platforms
pros.detail: Google Play and App Store apps, desktop edition.

cons.title: Privacy trade-off
cons.detail: All page content is rendered on private servers.

cons.title: Subscription needed
cons.detail: Google Play app free to download but needs a paid plan to function (unless OEM-paid).

cons.title: Site limits
cons.detail: Only publicly reachable sites from the US; no intranets or geo-restricted sites per App Store listing.

cons.title: Conflicting pricing info
cons.detail: Cloudwards says free ad-supported, contradicting store listings.

faq.a: The app downloads free but store listings say a subscription is required to use it unless an OEM pays.
HTML rendering runs in the cloud; display rasterization stays on the device.
Reviewers worry about content rendering on private servers.

timeline.event: Enterprise Puffin Secure Browser sold quote-only (Sendwin)
Capterra, G2 and Cloudwards still cover the product

pageLoad: Cloud rendering helps weak devices, adds latency
privacyDefaults: All content rendered on vendor servers
securityHardening: Remote isolation keeps content off device
searchFreedom: Default search changeable; AI prompt flow is the focus
webCompat: Fails on intranet and geo-restricted sites

featureNotes.adBlocker: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite
featureNotes.mv2Support: MV2 removed upstream; Chrome Web Store dropped MV2 Aug 31, 2026
